title: Named-agent recency state (recall compass)
description: Machine-owned most-recent-first list of the last 5 projects a named agent interacted with. Written only by flume; never prompt text. Used to order or narrow the employee's declared personal recall banks.

employee.description: The named person's name (identity.name / specialist id), not a registry post id.

entries.description: Most-recent-first; deduplicated by project; the 6th interaction evicts the oldest.

project.description: Project identity as resolved by the touching caller (registry project id or repo name).

source.description: Interaction source label, e.g. manual, hook:session-start, candystore-replay. Observable and replayable.
